arguments.task: Review a bugfix patch: localization wizard asks for required page fields via FormEngine step, localize command accepts fieldValues, FormEngine permission check for new page translations

arguments.message:
[BUGFIX] Ask for required fields when translating a page

The localization wizard created page translations with required fields
left empty, like a title without l10n_mode. It now asks for them in a
FormEngine step, as the page wizard does for a new page, and passes the
values to the localize command, which now accepts them as fieldValues.

To render that step for editors who may translate but not create pages,
FormEngine checks a new page translation like DataHandler does: page
edit permission on the default language page instead of page creation
permission on its parent page.

Resolves: #87328
Releases: main, 14.3
Change-Id: I5bb50ec12503518871e9aef429ad51dc9697f0c2
